column1: # Cases in cases.tsv whose result from the current CLI differs from the
# release named below, found by `differential.py compare-release` on
# ubuntu-24.04. Each line names what differs (codelength, tree, order, flow,
# error; see README.md) and the issue or PR numbers of the RESULT_CHANGES.csv
# rows that explain it. The check fails on a difference that is not listed and
# on a listed one that no longer shows, so the list stays exact.
# After a release, set the reference to the new tag and empty the list.
